mapper.sql: message_id, device_id, binding_generation, kind, target_code, desired_sequence, schedule_id, scheduled_at, data_json::text AS data_json, acknowledgement_policy, acknowledgement_timeout_millis, retry_policy, status, attempt_count, expires_at, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM iot_downlink_message WHERE device_id = #{deviceId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM iot_downlink_message WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND last_ack_code IS NOT NULL

SELECT message_id, last_ack_code AS ack_code, last_ack_data_json::text AS data_json, last_ack_source AS source, last_ack_source_acknowledgement_id AS source_acknowledgement_id, last_acknowledged_at AS acknowledged_at, last_ack_received_at AS received_at FROM iot_downlink_message WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND last_ack_code IS NOT NULL ORDER BY last_ack_received_at DESC, message_id DESC OFFSET #{offset} LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM iot_downlink_message WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND binding_generation = #{bindingGeneration} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'SENDING', 'WAITING_ACK')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iot_downlink_message ( message_id, device_id, binding_generation, kind, target_code, desired_sequence, schedule_id, scheduled_at, data_json, acknowledgement_policy, acknowledgement_timeout_millis, retry_policy, status, attempt_count, expires_at) VALUES (#{messageId}, #{deviceId}, #{bindingGeneration}, #{kind}, #{targetCode}, #{desiredSequence}, #{scheduleId}, #{scheduledAt}, CAST(#{dataJson} AS JSONB), #{acknowledgementPolicy}, #{acknowledgementTimeoutMillis}, #{retryPolicy}, 'PENDING', 0, #{expiresAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE iot_downlink_message SET last_ack_identity_hash = #{identityHash}, last_ack_code = #{ackCode}, last_ack_data_json = CAST(#{dataJson} AS JSONB), last_ack_source = #{source}, last_ack_source_acknowledgement_id = #{sourceAcknowledgementId}, last_acknowledged_at = #{acknowledgedAt}, last_ack_received_at = #{receivedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE message_id = #{messageId} AND last_ack_identity_hash IS DISTINCT FROM #{identityHash}
mapper.delete: WITH expired AS ( SELECT message_id FROM iot_downlink_message WHERE completed_at < #{completedBefore} AND status IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'SUPERSEDED', 'CANCELLED', 'EXPIRED') ORDER BY completed_at, message_id LIMIT #{batchSize} ) DELETE FROM iot_downlink_message AS message USING expired WHERE message.message_id = expired.message_id
